lean.statement:
{S : Type u_1} →
  {Q : Type u_2} →
    {A : Type u_3} → {X : Type u_4} → (S → X ⊕ Q) → (S → Q → A → S) → (Q → A) → ℕ → S → (S × Option X) × ℕ
approved_definition_context: Sum X Q (written X ⊕ Q) distinguishes a left output from a right query. Option X distinguishes some x from none. Pairs retain their ordered components.

The operator execute is defined by this structural recursion on natural fuel, with control inspected first: execute next update oracle fuel s matches next s. If it is inl x, return ((s,some x),0). If it is inr q and fuel is zero, return ((s,none),0). If it is inr q and fuel is n+1, obtain a=oracle(q), let tail=execute next update oracle n (update s q a), and return (tail.1,tail.2+1). The supplied policy, update and oracle are pure functions. Only this oracle branch increments the counter; computation inside those functions is not charged.
